```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/DMPs_10.000.csv')
DMPs_10.000 <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

Annotation mit Hypo Hyper für 10.000: 
```{r}
DMPs_10.000$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation' <-  ifelse(DMPs_10.000$logFC > 0, "Hypermethylation", "Hypomethylation")
```


Die ersten 1000 Methylierungsdaten aus dem original Datensatz heraus filtern:
```{r}
DMPs_1000 <- DMPs_10.000[1:1000,]
```

Annotation mit Hypo/Hyper für 1000: 
```{r}
DMPs_1000$'Hypomethylation/Hypermethylation' <-  ifelse(DMPs_1000$logFC > 0, "Hypermethylation", "Hypomethylation")
```

```{r}
significant_cpg_ids_1.000 <- rownames(DMPs_1000)
# Filtern und Sortieren der Zeilen in BRCA_methylation_original basierend auf den CpG-Ids in DMPS_10000
BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000 <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[significant_cpg_ids_1.000, ]

# Sicherstellen, dass die Reihenfolge der CpGs der Reihenfolge in DMPS_10000 entspricht
BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000 <- BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000[order(match(rownames(BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000), significant_cpg_ids_1.000)), ]
```

```{r}
#identische Bennung der Patient-ID  Bindestrich
colnames(BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000))
```

```{r}
#Subset des Annotation Dataframes mit dem Type
#drop=FALSE behält die Dimensionen
tissue_types <- BRCA_sample_sheet[,7, drop=FALSE]
```



```{r}
Hypo_hyper <- DMPs_1000[,40, drop=FALSE]
```

```{r}
# Libraries laden
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

annotation_color_1 <- list(tissue_types=c(`Hypermethylation`='chartreuse3', `Hypomethylation` = 'coral1'))

# Pearson-Korrelation zwischen den CpGs ausrechnen
CpG_cor_1.000 <- cor(t(BRCA_methylation_filtered_1.000))

# PDF speichern
pdf("Correlation_between_1000-sig_CpGs_with_hypo_hyper_annotation.pdf")

# Heatmap der Korrelation, geclustered mit complete linkage, Annotationen zum tissue Type
heatmap_cor_1.000_sigCpGs <- pheatmap(CpG_cor_1.000, 
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         annotation_col = Hypo_hyper, 
         annotation_row = Hypo_hyper,
         annotation_colors = annotation_color_1,
         annotation_legend = T,  # Legende entfernen
         annotation_names_row = FALSE,
         annotation_names_col = FALSE,
         cellwidth = 0.18,
         cellheight = 0.18,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("maroon4", "white", "darkgreen"))(100))

# PDF-Datei schließen
dev.off()
print(heatmap_cor_1.000_sigCpGs)

```
